app.title: Warehouse Manager
hud.help: Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom · WASD to move · Q/E to rotate · Space to pause · click anything for details
hud.start: The hall is empty. Build racks (B), then press Space to start the day.
toolbar.label: Building tools
build.hint: Point at the floor to place a rack. R turns it, right click or Esc puts the tool away.
build.error.out-of-bounds: A rack does not fit here.
build.error.blocks-access: This would cut off a door, a zone, stock or a person.
build.error.no-access: No aisle would reach this rack.
build.error.not-enough-cash: Not enough cash for a rack.
build.error.rack-in-use: Empty the rack first: it holds pallets or one is on its way.
demolish.hint: Click a rack to take it down. It must be empty. Half its price comes back.
truck.status.unloading: At the dock · {left} of {total} pallets still on board
activity.blocked: Cannot get through – the way is blocked
activity.step.unload: pulling a pallet off and checking it
order.title: Order {id}
finance.earnedNote: Fees are invoiced at the end of the month and paid 30 days later.
finance.noInvoices: None yet. The first invoices go out at the end of the month.
finance.lowest: Lowest: {amount} on day {day}. Counts rent, wages and invoices already issued.
context.rack.title: Rack {address}
context.rack.reach: The hand pallet jack only reaches level 1.
context.dock.title: Dock
build.error.staff-limit: The garage has room for three people.
build.error.unknown-worker: That person no longer works here.
build.error.last-worker: Someone has to run the place.
build.error.unknown-incident: That has already been dealt with.
people.training: In training until day {day}: half speed, twice the mistakes
people.unwell: Came in ill: starts every shift tired
people.leaving: Dismissed – finishing the task in hand
incident.cause.carelessPick: A picker took the wrong item. Accuracy, fatigue and training decide how often.
incident.cause.chaosPutaway: Without a system, pallets are put wherever there is room – and sometimes not where anyone remembers.
incident.cause.roughHandling: A pallet was lifted carelessly. Care and fragile goods decide how often.
incident.cause.tiredHandling: A tired worker lifted a pallet carelessly. Above 70 % fatigue accidents multiply.
incident.cause.lowMorale: Morale is low: unhappy people fall ill more often.
incident.cause.badLuck: People fall ill now and then; good morale keeps it rare.
incident.cause.slowUnloading: The truck at the dock is still being unloaded while the next one waits.
incident.cause.tooManyTrucks: More trucks in the same window than there are docks.
incident.wrong-shipment.title: Wrong item shipped
incident.wrong-shipment.text: {client} reports the wrong item in order {orderId}.
incident.wrong-shipment.choice.dispute: Dispute it (40 % nothing, else {disputeCost} and reputation −2)
incident.lost-goods.title: Goods cannot be found
incident.lost-goods.text: A pallet of {sku} is not where the records say. Orders for it are stuck.
incident.lost-goods.choice.count: Count the stock tonight ({countCost}, finds everything)
incident.lost-goods.choice.search: Send someone to search now (about {searchMinutes} min)
incident.sick-leave.title: Off sick
incident.sick-leave.text: {name} is ill and will be back on day {untilDay}.
incident.sick-leave.choice.temp: Get an agency temp until then ({tempWage}, inaccurate)
incident.sick-leave.choice.come-in: Ask them to come in anyway (morale −15, tired)
incident.dock-congestion.title: Truck stuck in the yard
incident.dock-congestion.text: A truck has waited {waited} for the dock. Demurrage starts after 2 h.
incident.dock-congestion.choice.all-hand: All hands to the dock for {allHandsMinutes} min (no picking)
incident.dock-congestion.choice.send-awa: Send it away and rebook ({rebookFee}, reputation −1)
incident.damaged-pallet.title: Pallet damaged
incident.damaged-pallet.text: A pallet of {sku} was damaged in handling.
incident.damaged-pallet.choice.write-off: Write off the damaged part ({compensation} to the client)
incident.damaged-pallet.choice.repack: Have it repacked ({repackCost}, about {repackMinutes} min of work)
build.error.unknown-offer: That offer is no longer on the table.
clients.offerText: {client} would like to store about {pallets} pallets with you and ship about {orders} orders a day.
toast.offer: {client} is offering a contract – see Clients (3).
toast.clientLeft.sla: {client} has left: the SLA was breached on three days this month.
toast.clientLeft.reputation: {client} did not renew: your reputation is too low.
toast.slaBreached: SLA breached for {client} today: {days} of {max} such days this month and they leave.
toast.badSave: That file is not a save of this version of the game.
menu.label: Game
menu.newConfirm: Start over? The saved game will be replaced.
onboarding.title: First day – {done} of {total}
onboarding.step.1: Build a rack (B) – the goods need somewhere to go.
onboarding.step.2: Take in a truck: press Space and wait for the 08:00–10:00 delivery.
onboarding.step.3: Get a pallet put away into a rack.
onboarding.step.6: Read the report at the end of the day.
build.error.game-over: The business is insolvent. Start a new game.
putaway.title: Put-away
putaway.note.chaos: Pallets go to any free slot: fast sellers end up far away and things get lost.
putaway.note.fixed: Every SKU has its place near its other pallets: shorter picks, far fewer lost pallets.
toast.overdraft: Cash is negative: day {days} of {max} of the overdraft. After that the bank calls it in.
gameover.title: Insolvent
gameover.text: Cash stayed below zero for {max} days and the bank has called in the overdraft. You lasted {days} days.
report.title: Day {day} report
report.inboundDetail: {received} pallets received, {putAway} put away, {trucks} trucks, {wait} min waiting
report.outboundDetail: {shipped} orders shipped ({pallets} pallets), {late} late, {open} still open
